rows.review: The modal “can” is retained by “yi nga”; “behind it” remains endzhaku ka yona; design and care are said to matter. Do not upgrade the claim to a guarantee.

interpretation: The doubtful geometric relation remains visible as exact English. The separate shelter claim retains its modal “can,” behind direction, and design/care condition.
